description: Get one precomputed AI weekly news recap from the database. Use this when the user asks for a weekly market recap, this week's/last week's AI news summary, or the dominant market themes across a week. Weekly recaps follow ISO week ids in YYYY-Www format and cover Monday through Sunday in US Eastern dates. If weekId is provided, it is used directly. If date is provided, the tool returns the week containing that date. If neither weekId nor date is provided, this automatically returns the latest available weekly recap. Set includeDaily=true only when the user asks for the day-by-day inputs or wants daily source headlines.

date.description: US Eastern date inside the desired week, e.g. 2026-05-12. Ignored when weekId is supplied.

includeDaily.description: If true, append source daily recap dates and headlines. Default: false.

weekId.description: ISO week id, e.g. 2026-W19. Takes precedence over date when both are supplied.

name: get_weekly_news_recap
